items.summary: تصريحات مثيرة من المدافع السنغالي المخضرم
items.body: تصريحات مثيرة من المدافع السنغالي المخضرم كشف السنغالي كاليدو كوليبالي، مدافع فريق الهلال، سر تفوق "الزعيم" أمام القادسية خلال المباراة التي جمعت الطرفين، أمس الجمعة، ضمن منافسات الجولة 11 من بطولة دوري روشن السعودي للمحترفين. اقرأ أيضًا.. خاص لـ "كووورة": هل يرحل إنزاجي عن الهلال؟ وحقق الهلال الفوز على القادسية بنتيجة 3-2، فالشوط الأول انتهى بهدف لكلٍ منهما، ما تسبب في غضب الإيطالي سيموني إنزاجي، مدرب "الزعيم"، لأنه كان يرغب في تسجيل أكبر عدد ممكن من الأهداف، وهو ما كشف عنه كوليبالي. تذاكر مباريات دوري روشن السعودي اشتر تذكرتك الآن! وقال كوليبالي في تصريحات لوسائل الإعلام: "إنزاجي كان غاضبًا من اللاعبين بين شوطي اللقاء، وتحدث معنا في غرفة خلع الملابس، على ضرورة التسجيل في الشوط الثاني". وأضاف: "إنزاجي أبلغنا أن فريقنا كان يمكنه تسجيل أكبر عدد ممكن من الأهداف في الشوط الأول، ولكن الفريق لم يفعل ذلك، وطالبنا بفرض سيطرتنا وعدم فقدان الكرة، وهو ما حدث وحصدنا نقاط المباراة". 🎥 مدافع #الهلال كوليبالي يكشف في حديث خاص معنا عما دار في غرفة الملابس بين شوطي لقاء القادسية . غضب إنزاغي وماذا طلب من اللاعبين ؟ pic.twitter.com/ghMSgvGcUj — حمد الصويلحي (@H_swilhy) October 23, 2026 وبهذا الانتصار، انتزع "الزعيم" صدارة ترتيب دوري روشن برصيد 27 نقطة، متفوقًا على النصر والقادسية بفارق نقطتين.

items.title: YouTuber escapes the modern AI tech market by recreating his 1996 PC
items.summary: Exhaustion with tech market prompt Youtuber to remake their first PC — 1996 build fueled by nostalgia and AI weariness
items.body: These days, it's exceedingly difficult not to be jaded and weary about the tech market. Memory, graphics cards, and now storage are becoming impossible to obtain; there's basically no new consumer hardware being released; and there's AI everywhere. Technology YouTuber TrashBench (TB), too, is tired and was harkening back to the halcyon days when everything was fresh and straightforward — so he went back in time with a retro build. More specifically, he recreated a facsimile of the first machine his parents bought him in 1996 when he was a wee lad, to play The Need for Speed: Special Edition — a PC-improved version of the first ever game in the series. According to the man, it was thanks to this machine that he fell in love with computers in general. items.summary: Fascinating footage captured inside a busy CompUSA retail store in Y2K lets you relive the PC era when translucent acrylic Presarios and iMacs roamed the Earth.
items.body: A video purported to be “authentic, original 360p footage captured inside a CompUSA retail store in New York City” has been shared on YouTube, allowing retro computing fans to step back in time to November 2000. This was the Windows Me , Pentium III, and Athlon era, dominated by computers constructed using a lot of translucent plastics and beige boxes already a distant memory. However, computer stores like this bulged with displays and fast-selling stock before internet shopping would start to eat many of these businesses away. The video reveals a nostalgic CompUSA, greeted by a wall of CRT monitors . The store looks crowded and almost chaotic with peripherals, PCs, and devices - and boxes filling a lot of space in the aisles. The first item is a noteworthy trio of laptops. It looks like three stylish Sony VAIO machines in a line. In the center of this display is probably the most interesting device from the time, which we believe to be a Sony VAIO C1 Series ‘PictureBook’ PCG-C1VN subnotebook. items.body: هل ينتفض الملكي في الكلاسيكو؟ تحدث جوزيه مورينيو، مدرب ريال مدريد ، عن مواجهة برشلونة، غدا الأحد، في الجولة الـ10 من الدوري الإسباني. وقال مورينيو، في المؤتمر الصحفي للمباراة : "نمر بفترة جيدة، ونلعب بشكل جيد ونسجل الأهداف، لكن ما فعلناه في السابق لا قيمة له في الكلاسيكو، ولن يكون له أي تأثير. إنها مباراة مختلفة تمامًا". وأضاف: "دروس من خسارة برشلونة برباعية أمام باريس؟ "لا أعتقد أن الهزيمة في مباراة واحدة ستغير حالة الفريق النفسية أو مستوى ثقته بنفسه. وبالمثل، لم يكن ذلك ليغير حالتي أنا أيضًا لو خسرنا أمام لايبزيج بنتيجة 1-4". وسئل مورينيو "هل ستضع خطة خاصة لإيقاف لامين يامال؟".. وأجاب: "جميع لاعبي برشلونة جيدون، والأمر نفسه ينطبق على ريال مدريد. إنه لاعب كبير، واللاعبون الكبار يجب احترامهم. لكن هناك فرقًا بين احترام المنافس وبين تغيير الخطط والهياكل التكتيكية والتخلي عن هويتك. لن نفعل ذلك، لا أمامه ولا أمام أي لاعب آخر يتمتع بهذه الجودة الاستثنائية". وطلب صحفي من المدرب البرتغالي إبداء رأيه في هانز فليك، مدرب برشلونة، ورد "سبيشيال وان": "لا أفهم الأسئلة المتعلقة بالمنافسين. إنه مدرب كبير ويقدم عملًا ممتازًا. ماذا تريدون مني أن أقول؟". ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة

items.title: China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing
items.summary: China has stretched older DUV lithography far further than expected, using multiple patterning to approach 5nm-class without EUV. But experts say the trade-offs in cost, yield, and die size mean further advancements are unlikely to be economically viable.
items.body: Export controls have kept ASML's most advanced EUV lithography machines out of China. Instead, the country's chipmaking industry has relied on less-capable deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines. By using multiple exposures on critical chip layers, these older machines are still capable of producing performant silicon. However, as multiple patterns are applied there are more chances for defects, longer manufacturing times, and higher bills. We spoke to experts like Chris Mack, co-founder and CTO of semiconductor firm Fractilia , to find out how much further DUV can go. For years, extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography has been seen as China’s biggest choke point in the country’s attempts to build cutting-edge chips. The machines, made exclusively by Dutch manufacturer ASML, use 13.5nm-wavelength light to print some of the most intricate features found on modern processors. Sales of ASML’s EUV systems are subject to export restrictions , forcing Chinese manufacturers to squeeze ever more out of older deep ultraviolet, or DUV, lithography instead. items.summary: A security firm has been able to identify 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 AI chips running inside a China Telecom network, but it's unclear where the export-barred components are physically located.
items.body: Lava, an Israeli security firm, says that it has been able to identify 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 chips within the network of China Telecom, a state-owned company that provides telecommunications services within the country. These same chips have already been barred from export by U.S. export controls, a report by The Information notes, which begs the question of how they have turned up in a Chinese data center. Such chips can only be sold to whitelisted buyers who agree not to export them to sanctioned parties, including those in China. However, banning companies from buying Nvidia's high-performance GPUs and AI data center chips hasn't always worked. In 2025, it was reported that Chinese companies smuggled $1 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips into the country in three months. At the time, the B200 chips were the most sought-after, but some distributors were already gearing up to sell B300-series chips when they became available. While the latest finding shows that the proliferation of export-controlled chips into China continues to be an issue, Nvidia has downplayed the report but didn't deny the findings. items.title: FCC issues first bans under new chip-level rule
items.summary: FCC bans a dashcam and wireless video transmitter produced by HiSilicon, a subsidiary of Huawei for containing an AI chip that advertises face detection algorithms.
items.body: The FCC recently imposed a new rule allowing it to ban devices based on the internal chips instead of basing bans on individual products or brands, thus closing the loophole of rebranded products with parts from Chinese manufacturers on US export restriction lists. Using this new rule, the FCC has banned two devices from being sold and marketed in the US for the first time: a dashboard camera and a wireless video transmitter. As reported by The Verge, these devices were banned due to the HiSilicon Smart Vision SoC (System on a Chip) they contain, which features built-in detection algorithms for faces. HiSilicon is a subsidiary of Huawei, and the firm and its subsidiaries are on the FCC’s Covered List of entities that pose a risk to US national security. The Hi3516CV610 UHD Smart Vision is an SoC for surveillance and camera products. The SoC is meant to be used for things like vehicle dashcams and wireless CCTV systems; fully equipped with WiFi, Ethernet, video encoding chips, an Arm Cortex-A7, and an NPU (Neural Processing Unit) for AI features. items.title: Deepseek's latest AI model is smarter than ever, but its low running costs come at a price
items.summary: Deepseek 4.1 Flash 1017 drives cost-per-task further down still — open-weight model is fit for agentic workloads and exceedingly cheap to run
items.body: Deepseek just upgraded its V4.1 Flash open-weight model to revision 1017. What looks like a mere point revision may actually be a significant step forward in model efficiency. On the product page , Deepseek uses the slogan "wish-driven programming made real," a likely reference to the colloquial "vibe coding," implying the model is a good fit for open-ended tasks with broad descriptions. However, while the model is indeed cheap and scores well, it can be hallucination-prone. LLMs are roughly divided into two categories: closed commercial efforts from frontier labs, whose models are expensive to run but deliver excellent results, and Chinese open-weight competitors that broadly exchange reliability for a much cheaper running cost, particularly for long-running agentic tasks. Deepseek V4.1 Flash (DSF) is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B total parameters, 16B of which are active during runs. The model is multimodal, accepts both text and images as inputs, and its context window length measures the now-standard 1 million tokens. items.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity
items.summary: Several U.S. banks are blocking AI agents from making transactions on their platforms. They fear that those agents could go rogue and there's no way to tell if the moves they make are legitimate or not.
items.body: A new report claims that major U.S. banks have now detected AI agents accessing customer accounts, and that some are even attempting to make transactions. Axios reports that it’s hard to differentiate between an actual human and an unauthorized bot, which is why some institutions, including Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, JPMorgan, and Wells Fargo, are blocking the technology and changing their terms of service to account for this. While an AI agent or AI assistant can access an account with a user’s permission and through the use of their login credentials, this often goes against bank policy that requires users to maintain control of their account and not share it with anyone else. One of the fears that executives have is when an AI agent with login access takes unauthorized steps, like spending money or moving funds around without the explicit instructions of the account owner. There have even been situations where an AI agent called the bank directly and took actions independent of direct user command. items.title: Claude and Grok among AI agents used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions
items.summary: Claude and Grok are among the AI agents that are being used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions, including banks and payment apps, by a group calling themselves CyberCartel.
items.body: CyberCartel, a hacking group with a long history of targeting Latin American businesses, has been using AI agents, including SpaceX's Grok and Anthropic's Claude, to automate attacks on financial institutions such as banks and mobile payment apps. Passwords and customer data have been stolen, while individuals' bank accounts have also been accessed with little input from criminals in the latest example of criminals turning to AI-powered cyberattacks . That research comes from a cybersecurity startup called Straiker, with its findings shared by The Information . While CyberCartel has been an active threat since at least 2012, its new leveraging of the power of AI has leveled up its attacks in recent months. Now, the research shows that the group can attack more businesses at a speed previously not possible when using human-powered hacks. Straiker shared its research with both SpaceX and Anthropic, and both firms are working to lock CyberCartel out of their services. The latter has already been able to block access to Claude. According to them, while a "complete data read" wasn't possible, the first 32KB of data was, a "technically unique" result. The PSA notes, however, that the game data is otherwise "completely identical" to the U.S. release version of the game, with PSA "expressing confidence" that the rest of the data, if it were readable, would match. items.title: The original Apple iPod debuted 25 years ago today
items.summary: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing 'a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.'
items.body: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing “a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.” Ultimately, the iPod that was revealed that day became a pocket-sized digital music player phenomenon, and would be many gadget fans' favorite always-carry device before smartphones matured enough to make such things redundant. The key claim iPod launched with was that it could put your entire music library in your pocket for $399. In October 2001, when the iPod launched, Steve Jobs had successfully steered Apple beyond the beige into the Mac OS X era, with iBooks and iMacs well established. A revival of the Cupertino company's fortunes was well underway, with these iDevices doing well among consumers – at a difficult time, not long after the dot-com bubble burst. Jobs predicted that the “Mac could become the center of your digital lifestyle.” It would do so as a hub uniting digital cameras, digital camcorders, DVD players – and the portable music player. items.body: In a world where SSDs with up to 256TB capacity are about to enter the scene to compete against hard disk drives that store over 40TB, magnetic tape storage may seem archaic. However, the 25-year-old Linear Tape-Open (LTO) format continues to evolve at a rather impressive pace. The current LTO-10 generation stores up to 40TB of uncompressed data per cartridge, while HPE, IBM, and Quantum — the companies behind the LTO Program — now envision LTO-14 cartridges with up to 365TB of native capacity. But capacity is not the only advantage of LTO. In fact, the consortium has deliberately slowed its capacity roadmap in a bid to prioritize reliability, cost per terabyte, and manageable backup and recovery times over the previous goal of doubling capacity with every generation. LTO began in 2000 with the LTO-1 format, which stored just 100GB of data natively and transferred it at 20 MB/s. items.title: Why you don't need an audiophile headset for gaming — comfort, convenience, and a good mic win over pure audio fidelity
items.summary: Headsets are mainly about audio, but that doesn't mean that the "objectively" best-sounding headset by audiophile standards translates to the best-sounding headset by gaming standards.
items.body: "Best gaming headset for audiophiles" is one of the categories on our list of best gaming headsets , and it's easy to look at that and wonder if you shouldn't be looking at just audiophile headsets to begin with. Headsets are mainly about audio, after all, and it does seem to logically follow that audiophile headsets would have the best audio (I mean, it's in the name). Well, not so fast. Headsets are mainly about audio, but that doesn't mean that the "objectively" best-sounding headset by audiophile standards translates to the best-sounding headset by gaming standards. Nor does it mean that you should choose your gaming headset based on audio quality at the expense of everything else. Audiophile headsets , including headphones, are primarily designed around one thing: audio fidelity. In other words, they're designed and tuned to reproduce audio exactly as it was recorded, which is exactly as the artist heard it when they were recording it, and is therefore exactly as the artist intended for it to be heard.
